source_summary: Vertical ink landscape with pale washes and fine dry linework: layered mountains in the upper half, a central cliff massif, distant misty peaks, winding watercourses with wooded banks, small architectural elements, and foreground rock-and-tree groups. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: left_craggy_peak_group
motifs.description: Tall left-side mountain cluster with steep rounded summits and descending ridges, isolated from the blank sky and lower cliff face.
must_preserve: fine dry contour lines following the mountain folds
arched ridge strokes and layered wrinkle texture
pale ink wash at the rear left peak silhouette
small dark tree and brush accents along the ridgelines
soft misty fading at the lower edges

motifs.name: central_misty_back_peaks
motifs.description: Distant central background peaks seen through mist between the left and right mountains.
must_preserve: soft grey wash silhouettes of far peaks
blurred mist edges with no hard outlines in the upper forms
light dry contour marks on the nearer central ridge
open negative space separating the peaks
subtle tonal transition from pale wash to bare paper

motifs.name: right_rounded_mountain
motifs.description: Rounded upper-right mountain mass with sloping shoulders and sparse textural strokes, separated from the village and water below.
must_preserve: curved contour lines wrapping the dome-like summit
short broken texture strokes on the upper ridge
pale wash and open mist at the base
thin descending slope lines toward the center valley
small dark accents suggesting shrubs or trees on the crest

motifs.name: central_cliff_massif
motifs.description: Large central rocky cliff platform with vertical faces, broken ledges, and a narrow ravine descending from the mountains.
must_preserve: vertical cliff striations and long dry ink cracks
blocky rock ledges with angular outlines
dark crevice accents in the central ravine
rounded top ridges with layered wrinkle strokes
small shrubs and sparse tree marks attached to cliff edges

motifs.name: right_bank_village_bridge
motifs.description: Small village and bridge group on the middle-right bank, including houses, a low bridge or railing, trees, and adjacent shoreline.
must_preserve: tiny roof geometry with eaves and rectangular wall lines
horizontal bridge or railing segments crossing the bank
slender bare trees and clustered shrubs around the structures
light waterline strokes beside the bank
delicate scale contrast between architecture and surrounding landscape

motifs.name: winding_river_islands
motifs.description: Broad winding water surface through the middle and lower painting, with curving banks, rocky islets, and sparse riverside vegetation.
must_preserve: large unpainted water areas bounded by thin ink shorelines
curving S-shaped river course receding downward
low rocky islets with dry texture strokes
small reed and grass marks along the banks
scattered delicate tree clusters rising from islands and peninsulas

motifs.name: lower_shore_pavilion
motifs.description: Small thatched riverside pavilion or hut near the lower center-left, with nearby shoreline, rocks, and thin trees.
must_preserve: simple sloped roof silhouette with light eave lines
short vertical support posts beneath the roof
surrounding low rocks and bank contour lines
nearby fine sapling and bamboo-like strokes
quiet open water space around the pavilion

motifs.name: lower_right_foreground_rocks_trees
motifs.description: Foreground rock cluster at the lower right with rounded boulders, shoreline ledges, and tall sparse trees at the edge.
must_preserve: rounded boulder contours with layered wrinkle texture
dark crevice marks at rock bases
thin bare tree trunks with small branching twigs
small leafy shrub accents near the rocks
foreground shoreline lines anchoring the cluster

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
